definitions.explanation: A love that ends sadly or is doomed from the start, often due to circumstances beyond the lovers' control.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悲恋|ひれん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a story of tragic love.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悲恋|ひれん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誘|さそ}った→誘う：01947_sasou⟧。
examples.english: Their tragic love story moved many people to tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{裂|さ}かれた→引き裂く：12459_hikisaku⟧{悲恋|ひれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A movie depicting a tragic romance torn apart by war was released.

notes:
Composed of {悲|ひ} (sad, tragic) + {恋|れん} (love, romance). A literary and dramatic term used to describe love stories with unhappy endings — separation, death, social barriers, or unrequited love. Very common in descriptions of novels, films, and historical romances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲恋|ひれん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧: tale of tragic love
- {悲恋|ひれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: depict a tragic romance
- {悲恋|ひれん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: end in tragic love
- {悲恋|ひれん}⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: tragic love novel
- {悲恋|ひれん}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧: tragic romance film

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{失恋|しつれん}→失恋：04195_shitsuren⟧: heartbreak, broken love (more everyday/personal)
- ⟦{悲劇|ひげき}→悲劇：03577_higeki⟧: tragedy (broader, not limited to love)
- ⟦{純愛|じゅんあい}→純愛：25311_junai⟧: pure love (can be tragic or happy)
- ⟦{片思|かたおも}い→片思い：16834_kataomoi⟧: unrequited love (one-sided, may not be tragic)
